RAG models combine retrieval-based and generative approaches and have been proposed as a way to address some of the drawbacks of basic generative language models in information-seeking scenarios. They improve the factual accuracy of answers to low-frequency queries as well as prediction consistency. These models employ a retriever to gather relevant external information and a generator to produce responses.

The study investigates how the ATLAS model generates answers by relying on either parametric memory (internal knowledge) or non-parametric memory (retrieved context), particularly in response to factual questions.
